dedupe_keys.name: uci water treatment plant dataset urban wastewater plant daily sensor measures

description: The Water Treatment Plant dataset in the UCI Machine Learning Repository holds daily measures from the sensors of an urban wastewater treatment plant, donated in May 1993, with 527 instances and multiple classes describing the operational state. The stated objective is to classify the operational state of the plant, so that faults can be predicted from the plant's state variables at each stage of the treatment process; the page calls this an ill-structured domain. The variables table lists 38 variables, and the repository classes it as multivariate with integer and real features, suited to clustering. The page says the data have no missing values in its summary while the variables table carries per-variable notes. Coverage: one plant and a short daily record, without dates or location in the summary. Access: free download; the licence is CC BY. Caveats: old, small, anonymised, and not tied to a specific plant model. It supports fault detection and process state classification for wastewater treatment digital twin work, and relates to the BSM2 dataset in the catalogue.
